== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ラルティア</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">自分の宇宙船は“リアクション”としてここに移動できる。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">自分の大型艦は配備コスト－2。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Ralltiir]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — The printed game-text box is blank.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Dark text names 大型艦. English says capital starships. Light text matches a react move here. One Light Force icon and one Dark Force icon.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-ralltiir.gif|Original English face]], [[Ralltiir]].</ref>
